verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents continuous daily monitoring with alerts for failing tests and proactive email notifications, plus integrations with Jira/Slack for tasks/notifications and ticketing sync for follow-up tasks. However, evidence doesn't clearly confirm that failure/drift alerts themselves (not just access-review or vendor tasks) are routed to Slack, and no detail is given on the context/remediation info included in alerts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that continuous-monitoring failing-test alerts (not just reviews) can be sent to Slack, and evidence of alert content richness (e.g., remediation guidance, affected resource details) in the alert itself.
